ads.headline: Lead gen interest dropping—service businesses must differentiate offers now
actions: Audit your ad copy: replace generic 'get a quote' with specific pain-point solutions (e.g., 'Fix burst pipes same-day, $0 callout fee')
Test a $25/day split: $15 on proven audiences, $10 on lookalikes of past converters to offset declining category interest
Add urgency scarcity: 'Limited slots this week' or '2-hour response guarantee' to stand out when competition increases during lower-interest periods
ads.source: Google Trends lead generation interest at 11/100 (historically higher); r/FacebookAds weekly patterns showing increased competition during seasonal dips

creative.headline: Can't give strategic recommendation — zero engagement data this week
actions: STOP: You have no performance data to analyze. Google Trends shows 0-0-0 across all metrics, and no complaints/failures are listed.

Before I can recommend hooks, formats, or video ideas, you need: Instagram Insights (top 3 posts this week by saves/shares/DMs), audience comments on recent posts, and any negative feedback or low-performing content patterns.

My recommendations would be guessing, not strategy. Collect this week's actual data first: Which posts got DMs? What hooks got replies? What content flopped? Then I'll give you specific, winning angles.
creative.source: Incomplete data set — cannot provide reliable strategic recommendation

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
